title: Geography
description: Geographical coverage of a pathway. 'global' marks whole-world coverage (a literal flag, not a list of every country). 'country' maps each country the publication names to the ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes the publication includes in it, keyed by that country's own code: 'CN': ['CN', 'HK', 'MO'], or 'JP': ['JP']. 'regions' maps every other area, under the publication's own label, to the two or more codes it contains. A key's shape says what it is: a country is keyed by an assigned ISO2 code, a region never is (#1071).

global.description: True if the pathway covers the entire world.

regions.description: Map from a region label, as named in the publication, to the ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in that region. A label is never an assigned ISO2 code: an area the publication names as one country belongs in 'country', even when it includes several codes. Every region has at least two members.

country.description: Map from a country's ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code to the codes the publication includes in it, the key among them. Usually just the key ('JP': ['JP']); a publication that counts territories with their country lists them too ('US': ['US', 'PR', 'VI']). Membership follows the source. That the key is one of its own members, and that a code belongs to at most one country, are checked by validateScopedEntries in src/utils/validateScopes.ts.
